vulnerability.name: USN-5264-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that graphviz contains null pointer dereference  vulnerabilities. Exploitation via a specially crafted input file  can cause a denial of service. (CVE-2018-10196, CVE-2019-11023)  It was discovered that graphviz contains a buffer overflow  vulnerability. Exploitation via a specially crafted input file can cause a denial of service or possibly allow for arbitrary code execution.  (CVE-2020-18032)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in graphviz. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
